text: Which troubleshooting approach do experienced engineers use most, and what does it require?
choices: Follow-the-path; knowledge of the topology, which is what documentation is for
Divide and conquer; a packet capture
explanation: It finds faults the layered methods miss because the fault is BETWEEN two things that are each individually fine. Divide-and-conquer is the sensible default; follow-the-path is what you graduate to.
